## isHexEqual() function

Compares hex strings case-insensitively.

**Signature:**

```typescript
isHexEqual: (left: string, right: string) => boolean
```

Whether both hex strings are equal after lowercase normalization.

## Example


```ts
import { isHexEqual } from "@morpho-org/morpho-ts";
```
